title: Guarded fill drain sequence
prompt: State INT initially 0 idle. Abort has priority, clears State to 0 and Done false. Otherwise State0: Done false and Start moves to1; State1: Full moves to2; State2: Empty moves to3; State3: Done true and Reset moves to0 and clears Done. Invalid state returns0. At most one state transition per scan. After transition compute Fill=(State=1), Drain=(State=2), Done=(State=3).
scan_semantics: Inputs sampled before scan; outputs checked after same scan. Variables persist between scans. Each test starts at declarations initial values. Unspecified inputs retain their last value. Timer first enabling scan ET=0.

provenance.synthesis_process: Authored from a named industrial control scenario; fixed interface, priority, scan convention, boundary tests and LTL obligations were designed together.
provenance.adaptations: Deterministic I/O abstraction; no physical I/O addressing or online control.
provenance.rationale: Guarded fill drain sequence is a common PLC control pattern; explicit limits make the task testable.
provenance.review_process: Automated schema, reference-fixture scan tests and finite-trace LTL consistency checks. Human PLC scenario/spec review is still required.
